A full card image re-made by the Players Committee with the mark D-E1 in the lower border (27 January 2024). Its words are the Players Committee's errata, not Decipher's.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-D-ivegotaproblemhere-PC-2024-D-E1-card-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[I've Got A Problem Here (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The game text changes: “finished.” becomes “ended.”. The whole card is drawn again at a larger size, with the mark “D-E1” in place of “E”.

The whole E card image and the whole D-E1 card image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
